usedFor: PostGrid Print & Mail sends letters, Google Docs logs them: “New Letter Created” runs “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Letter Created” in PostGrid Print & Mail, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new mailing is noted in a chosen document tab.

watchOut: “New Letter Created” is polling within a lookback window, and replace mode would overwrite earlier entries.
